Man Kills Four, Including Wife and Priests, Then Killed in Encounter

In Azamgarh, Uttar Pradesh, a man identified as Arvind Singh allegedly opened fire during a puja ceremony, killing his wife and two priests. The incident stemmed from a dispute that began in 2019 when Arvind's brother was murdered, reportedly over a woman named Babita. Following the puja killings, Arvind was killed in a police encounter.
